summary: Backend-only testing for ConKiosk Faculty Mobile App. Seeded DB via POST /api/seed and executed 25 pytest cases covering auth (login success/failure, JWT validation), faculty profile CRUD + persistence, availability toggle, dashboard stats, consultation requests (list/filter/accept/decline/reschedule/invalid-action/missing-fields), consultation history (list/filter/search/update+persist), notifications (list/mark-read/mark-all-read), and change-password (wrong-current/success + re-login + restore). All 25 tests PASSED (100%). DB re-seeded at the end so the frontend agent has clean state. No critical or minor backend issues detected. MongoDB _id is correctly serialized to string via serialize_doc; password_hash is stripped from responses; 401 returned for invalid/missing tokens (HTTPBearer returns 403 when Authorization header is absent, which is acceptable FastAPI behavior).

minor.issue: Returns 403 (from FastAPI HTTPBearer) instead of 401 when Authorization header is entirely missing. Bad/invalid tokens correctly return 401. Not blocking, but frontend must treat 401 and 403 as unauthenticated.

action_items: (Optional) Return 401 instead of 403 when Authorization header is missing, for consistency with README/spec. E.g. set auto_error=False on HTTPBearer and raise 401 manually.
(Optional) The /api/seed endpoint is destructive (wipes faculty/requests/consultations/notifications). Consider protecting it behind an env-guard before production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~700-line module; consider splitting into routers (auth, faculty, consultations, notifications) and a shared deps module.
Repeated `from bson.objectid import ObjectId` inside handlers should be moved to the top-level import.

No input validation for availability status enum ('available'/'busy'/'unavailable') or action enum server-side beyond a final 'else' branch; consider using Literal[...] on Pydantic models to reject bad values with 422.
ObjectId parsing is unguarded: passing a malformed request_id/consultation_id/notification_id raises bson.errors.InvalidId and returns 500. Wrap in try/except and return 400 or 404.
JWT_SECRET_KEY falls back to a hardcoded default; enforce env presence in production.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/seed at session start and re-called between destructive test classes; also re-seeded at end so DB has: 1 faculty (FAC2024001/password123), 3 pending requests, 2 completed consultations, 2 unread notifications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend not yet tested. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (note: it's EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Seed via POST /api/seed if state is stale. Login credentials: FAC2024001 / password123. Auth is JWT Bearer via Authorization header.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs to root-cause; all endpoints in the review scope behave as expected.
